bricks.label: struct MinHeap
bricks.plain_english: Defines the heap — an array to store elements and a size counter.
bricks.scene_description: An empty tree layout appears showing the array-to-tree mapping.

bricks.label: initHeap()
bricks.plain_english: Sets size to 0. An empty heap starts with no elements.

bricks.label: swap()
bricks.plain_english: Swaps two array elements. Used by siftUp and siftDown to move elements to their correct positions.
code_snippet: void swap(struct MinHeap* h, int i, int j) {
bricks.scene_description: Two nodes swap positions with a smooth animation.

bricks.label: siftUp()
bricks.plain_english: After an insert, bubbles a node up until the heap property is restored. Parent must always be smaller than child in a min-heap.
code_snippet: void siftUp(struct MinHeap* h, int i) {
bricks.scene_description: New node climbs upward, swapping with its parent until in the correct position.

bricks.label: siftDown()
bricks.plain_english: After extracting the minimum, pushes the replacement root down until the heap property is restored.
code_snippet: void siftDown(struct MinHeap* h, int i) {
if (l < h->size && h->arr[l] < h->arr[smallest]) smallest = l;
if (r < h->size && h->arr[r] < h->arr[smallest]) smallest = r;
if (smallest != i) { swap(h, i, smallest); siftDown(h, smallest); }
bricks.scene_description: Root node sinks downward, swapping with its smaller child each step.

bricks.label: insert()
bricks.plain_english: Places the new value at the end of the array and calls siftUp to restore the heap property.
code_snippet: void insert(struct MinHeap* h, int value) {
bricks.scene_description: New node appears at the bottom-right and floats up to its correct position.

bricks.label: extractMin()
bricks.plain_english: Removes the root (the minimum element), replaces it with the last element, and calls siftDown.
bricks.scene_description: Root fades. The last node jumps to the root position and sinks to its correct spot.

bricks.label: heapSort()
bricks.plain_english: Insert all elements into the heap, then call extractMin() repeatedly to produce sorted output.
code_snippet: for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) insert(&h, arr[i]);
for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) arr[i] = extractMin(&h);
bricks.scene_description: Full sort animation — elements are extracted one by one in ascending order.
